example.metrics: e.g. sum by (namespace) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m])). Scoped to the selected cluster automatically
example.logs: e.g. {namespace="doris"} |= "error". Broad aggregate queries can overwhelm the data source — narrow the selector first

findMetricHint: Confirm the metric exists first — a wrong name also returns empty, which reads as "component healthy"
sent: Query actually sent (may include an injected cluster selector)
notIsolated: ⚠️ This query could not be scoped to the selected cluster — results may include other clusters' data.
noLogs: No matching log lines. Wrong label, too short a range, or genuinely no logs — three different things, so do not read it as "no errors".

starter.title: Nothing queried yet. These run as-is, and double as a data-source check:

labelValues.label: Label values
labelValues.hint: Label name, e.g. namespace / pod / job
labelValues.count: {{n}} values (click one to append it to the query)
labelValues.empty: Label {{label}} has no values. The name may be wrong, or this data source may genuinely not have it — try a label you know exists (such as job) to check
